rev.t: Had one of the best team outings ever at Mudcast Pottery Studio, we had so much fun we didn't realise how quickly time passed. Meeta is a amazing teacher and makes you feel at home even while conducting the workshop. The studio is spacious, …

Meeta was so patient with all of us and taught us some Amazing techniques. We're beginners btw. She asked us if we had any ideas and helped us bring our ideas to life! A truly fun, calming and amazing experience for us! I Highly recommend it ❣️

Thanks Meeta.It was a wonderful experience.
calming, creative, and surprisingly joyful. Working with clay makes us slow down, focus, and create something with our  own hands. The feeling of shaping clay on the wheel, even if it turned  wobbly was  exciting and satisfying.
